title: When the Burgers Outsold the Ice Cream: Jollibee's Change of Course
conflicts: Start year: Rappler, WIPO and Ernesto Tanmantiong's 2023 speech give 1975 for the parlours (Tony was 22, born 1953); Gulf News says the franchise began in 1978: used 1975 for the parlours and 1978 for the switch to Jollibee. Stores when McDonald's arrived: Tony said 5 (2013 speech), Ernesto said 12 at McDonald's 1981 entry (2023 speech): story gives both with attribution. Parlour locations: both in Cubao (Rappler) vs Cubao and Quiapo (Gulf News): story names only Cubao.
notes: Company field set to plain 'Jollibee' because 'Foods'/'Corporation' triggered false same-company matches in the repeat screen. Founder accounts come from Tony's 2013 APEC speech (Rappler), the WIPO case study and his brother Ernesto's 2023 MAP speech; Jollibee's own milestones page needs JavaScript and was not cited.
